name: Futuristic
direction: Restrained futuristic infrastructure identity. A compact orbital docking mark: a broken circular ring shelters a small rounded rectangular device at one precise docking point, with a single electric-violet connector. Strong flat silhouette, asymmetry, clean negative space. Midnight #1E2047 and electric violet #7956EC. Custom extended sans-serif Berth wordmark. No glow, gradients, or science-fiction scenery.
prompt: Create ONE original logo concept for Berth, a self-hosted Android emulator fleet for AI agents and humans. The concept is a safe assigned dock for a borrowed device. Produce a professional isolated brand logo, with one symbol above one wordmark except for the typographic option. The only text must be Berth (or berth when specified). Center on a pure white square canvas with generous margins. Keep the full lockup within the central 70 percent. Flat vector artwork, crisp paths, recognizable small silhouette. No mockups, photographs, shadows, textures, explanatory labels, taglines, watermarks, multiple alternatives, or famous-brand imitation. Restrained futuristic infrastructure identity.
